_about: Lanbai ART BIBLE v2 resolved grade set. Colour Grading mode = High Definition Range, Tonemapper = Neutral in EVERY profile. Trackballs = PPv2 Vector4 (x,y,z wheel colour, max channel 1; w = offset). Every scene profile overrides the SAME full parameter set. Scene crossfade: incoming (higher priority) 0->1 while outgoing stays 1, then outgoing -> 0. PPv2 OVERRIDES ARE ABSOLUTE: param = lerp(current, override, weight). Helpers therefore carry FAR targets and the Director solves their weight every frame (see helpers._how).

helpers._how: PPv2 does param = lerp(current, override, weight). An exposure helper with a FAR target H (+4 or -4) gives exactly b + dEV when weight w = dEV / (H - b), where b = the postExposure already blended by the scene volumes below it (b = lerp(pe_old, pe_new, w_new) during a scene crossfade). The Director sums every exposure event active this frame (beat decay + flash + white ramp + mirror pulse) into ONE dEV(t) and sets EXPO_UP (dEV > 0) or EXPO_DOWN (dEV < 0). Route C (External LUT, profile postExposure = 0) is the same formula with b = 0.

events.break-out U6: +0.5 EV in 0.4 s, then 3 s linear decay (w_peak = 0.102 at b = -0.9)
events.U9 tube flash: +0.3 EV in 0.2 s, 0.5 s decay (w_peak 0.062 at b = -0.85)
events.FLASH_TEAR U12: desktop +1.5 EV in 0.4 s EV-linear, hold 0.1 s (w = 0.306 at b = -0.9); VR: min(+1.5, EV that brings APL to 150)
events.exit into dusk F9: +0.8 EV at the end of the >= 6 s ramp, 4 s decay (w_peak 0.178 at b = -0.5)
events.mirror pulse: +0.35 EV, 0.08 s in / 0.35 s out, w = 0.35 / (4 - b(t)); suppressed for crossings inside the white ramp (mirrors 10-12)
events.after the first white: +1.0 EV at weight solved against S11 (w = 0.241), 4 s decay, overlay fill compensated
events.after the second white: +0.8 EV against S12 (w = 0.200), 5 s decay, overlay fill compensated

events.water entry F2: -0.5 EV in 0.3 s, 1 s recovery (w_peak 0.156 at b = -0.8)

WHITE_SAT.weight: = white-ramp fraction: 0 -> 0.42 (crash) -> 1.0 (swell); hard-cut to 0 under the full overlay

WHITE_BLOOM.weight: crash 0 -> 0.5, swell -> 1.0, then 1 -> 0 EV-linearly WITH the 3 s overlay (so the overlay itself never blooms)

LENS_ARCHIVE.weight: U0 0 -> 1 over 8 s (the record starts); U3 1 -> 0 over 8 s (the sound opens); 10->11 0 -> 1 under the white; 11->12 1 -> 0 under the second white

LENS_CLEAN.weight: 1 everywhere on desktop (scene 1 included); LENS_ARCHIVE sits above it

_route_c_crossfade: External LUTs blend in display-linear light: for an exposure-changing crossfade drive w(t) = (2^(dEV*x) - 1)/(2^dEV - 1), x = 0..1
